safePointBarriers.trigger: AJumanjiAdventureChapterDirector.OnCheckpointBoundaryReady after a trial actor publishes Completed and objective progress agrees
requirements: No trial actor is InProgress or Dormant
Completed objective IDs and completed trial IDs agree
No enemy is alive and no spawn is pending
safePointBarriers.resumeMeaning: Restore the completed subset; remaining trials are unfinished logical objectives.

safePointBarriers.trigger: WorldEncounterDirector after the last enemy of a wave is defeated and before the next wave/boss is spawned
requirements: currentWave is the one-based last completed wave
safePointBarriers.resumeMeaning: Start the next wave; when currentWave equals totalWaves, spawn the boss.
Restore only boss definition, phase, health fraction and phase revision.

safePointBarriers.trigger: WorldEncounterDirector after boss defeat and before player reward transactions
safePointBarriers.resumeMeaning: Reconcile the reward intent against each participant profile ledger; never blind-pay a second time.
